Your responsibilities:

Interested?

Jobomschrijving

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.
• Support the loading of pallets and cartons onto trucks when required.
• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.
• Continuously identify opportunities to optimize transport efficiency and reduce shipping costs.

Your Profile

• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.
• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

The company  is een familie bedrijf actief in de Security wereld in België en Nederland. 

Jobomschrijving

Your Mission

•    Coordinate maintenance contracts and ensure contractual commitments are fulfilled.•    Plan and follow up preventive maintenance activities.•    Coordinate service reviews, reporting activities and follow-up actions.•    Monitor maintenance invoicing, renewals and contract amendments.•    Maintain contract documentation, service procedures and operational records throughout the contract lifecycle.•    Act as the operational reference for maintenance contracts and contract-related information across the company.•    Support engineers and internal teams with contract-related questions.•    Coordinate subcontractors and ensure service activities are properly tracked.•    Support customer communication and manage operational escalations when required.•    Identify risks, priorities and improvement opportunities before they impact service management.

During your journey at Tein Technology, you'll develop expertise in:•    Service Delivery & Contract Management•    Customer Relationship•    Operational Planning & Coordination•    Service Reporting & Business Performance Monitoring•    Mission-Critical Voice, Video & Network Services

POSITION’S REQUIREMENTS Education, Knowledge & Experience•    Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.•    Experience in service coordination, operations, administration or customer support.•    Strong organisational and planning skills.•    Interest in technology, customer service and operational excellence.What Makes You a Great Fit•    Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with a good command of English.•    Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.•    Customer-oriented with excellent communication skills.•    Proactive, action-driven and comfortable taking ownership.•    Commercial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and improvements.•    Comfortable coordinating engineers, customers and external partners.•    Structured and detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.•    Calm and effective under pressure.•    Curious about technology and service management.•    Eager to grow towards a Service Delivery Management role.

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.

Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.

Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.

To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.

Basic Requirements:

• Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.
• A solid understanding of electricity is a must.
• Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.
• Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.
• Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).
• No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).
• Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.
• Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.
Additional Information:

• You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).
• You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).
• You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.
• A driver’s license is not required.

Education, Knowledge & Work Experience:•    Relevant higher education or ongoing studies in office management, business management, administration, data analysis or a related field.•    Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, advanced formulas, data modelling and dashboarding.•    Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis.•    Experience with KPI development, SLA reporting and data quality management is an asset.•    Knowledge of ITIL processes and experience with CMDB environments are assets.•    Experience with Power Automate, VBA, Grafana or similar tools is an asset.Required skills:•    Strong analytical mindset and administrative accuracy.•    Structured way of working and excellent attention to detail.•    Ability to work independently and to prioritize tasks.•    Results-oriented and quality-focused approach.•    Excellent written communication skills.•    Ability to translate data into clear management information.•    Proactive attitude and focus on continuous improvement.Languages:•    Very good knowledge of Dutch, as communication is mainly internal.•    Good knowledge of French and English is an asset.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. The company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

Currently in a phase of significant growth, they are looking for motivated and dedicated team members to join their mission.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again.

Are you a (recent) graduate with a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences? Are you ready to put your knowledge and skills into practice in a setting where innovation meets purpose?

We’re looking for ambitious, detail-oriented professionals to help shape the future of medicine. At our leading biotech company, you won’t just find a job you’ll begin a meaningful, long-term career in advanced biomanufacturing.

Your journey starts with comprehensive training, where you’ll learn the fundamentals of aseptic (germ-free) techniques and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice), the key standards that guide our industry. You’ll quickly gain confidence with the tools, procedures, and mindset that define high-quality biotech production.

After onboarding, you’ll join our dynamic Operations team, working hands-on with cutting-edge technologies and sterile processes. Together with your colleagues, you’ll perform precise manual and aseptic production steps, always following clear protocols to guarantee patient safety and product quality.

What your day-to-day will look like:

• Contributing to aseptic and manual production processes
• Working in a cleanroom laboratory environment
• Performing production steps in controlled areas (grade A/B/C/D), such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products
• Managing equipment, including inspections and maintenance
• Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials
• Supporting transitions between production zones
• Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

• You’re eager to apply your scientific background and contribute to something meaningful, making a real difference in the lives of patients.
• You’re energized by dynamic environments and excited to keep learning and growing within advanced biomanufacturing.
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in biotechnology, chemistry, agro- or life sciences, and you’re ready to take the next step from the classroom to cutting-edge industry.
• You value structure and precision, and you feel comfortable working in a sterile (aseptic) setting, wearing the proper cleanroom gear.
• High-tech equipment and innovative processes spark your curiosity, you want to be part of what’s next.
• You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
• You’re a real team player with a strong eye for detail, and you understand the importance of following procedures carefully.
• You’re flexible and open to working in shifts.
• You’re excited about a 4-days-on, 4-days-off schedule that supports both focus and work-life balance.

Deze international is gespecialiseerd in de productie en de toelevering van kunststofonderdelen voor de automobielindustrie; spuitgietonderdelen voor voertuigen.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Gijzegem, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician m/f/x to work in a 2-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM). Are you technically skilled, eager to learn, and ready to roll up your sleeves? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for!

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for ensuring the optimal operation of our machinery and production equipment. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.

In addition, you will contribute to technical improvements and small-scale projects aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of our installations. A positive attitude and willingness to continuously develop your skills are just as important as your technical knowledge. Experience with PLC systems is a plus, and further training will be provided internally.

Your Responsibilities

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on injection molding machines, peripheral equipment, and testing systems.
• Quickly and efficiently diagnose and resolve faults in electrical, electronic, hydraulic, and mechanical systems.
• Independently execute small technical improvement projects.
• Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance machine performance and reliability.
• Help maintain a safe working environment and comply with environmental regulations.
• Contribute to housekeeping and cleanliness standards within the workshop and production areas.

• You have a technical education (A2 level, Associate Degree, or Bachelor's degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, Automation, or equivalent through experience).
• Knowledge of injection molding machines is an advantage.
• Basic knowledge of PLC controls is a plus; additional training can be provided internally.
• You have experience maintaining and repairing industrial machinery and equipment.
• Experience in a manufacturing environment and with preventive maintenance is a strong asset.
• You have a good command of Dutch.
• You can understand technical manuals and documentation in English and/or German.
• You have strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• You can efficiently solve electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.
• You take a proactive approach and contribute ideas to prevent future breakdowns.
• You are able to work independently on maintenance and repair activities.
• You are service-minded and enjoy collaborating with colleagues across different departments.
• You communicate clearly about technical issues and solutions.
• You work closely with production teams to minimize downtime.
